standings.deckUnavailable: We couldn’t decode this deck code, so the list is unavailable.
standings.note: Open a row to see the decklist the duelist registered. We compute rank and tiebreakers from the match records, because the game stores neither. OMW% is the average match-win rate of a duelist’s opponents, and OOMW% is the same figure for those opponents’ opponents. KTS packs points, OMW% and OOMW% into one eight-digit number that sets the order.

rounds.note: The engine’s outcome decides the match, even when the game score disagrees. A match can end 1–1 and still have a winner after a disconnect or a concession. Unplayed matches stay unplayed. “On the play” marks game 1 only, because the game’s record of who went first in games 2 and 3 is unreliable.

stats.goingFirstNote: “Won going first” counts game 1 only. The game stores the flag for every game, but the values for games 2 and 3 don’t hold up.
stats.noArchetypes: No entrant’s deck matched a known archetype.
stats.archetypesNote: The table counts every deck in the tournament, not a top cut. A heuristic assigns the archetype, so a hybrid deck takes the name of its bigger half. Byes don’t count as match wins here.
stats.matchupsMeta: Mirrors left out · {count, plural, one {# single-match pair hidden} other {# single-match pairs hidden}}
stats.topCardsNote: The record covers every deck that ran the card, in games, whether or not the card was drawn. Tournament duels keep no play log.
